explanation: The English article says the war "set the stage for the Second Congo War (1998–2003) due to tensions between Kabila and his former allies", and spells that out: Kabila sought to distance himself from his Rwandan and Ugandan backers, expelled foreign troops and allied instead with Angola, Zimbabwe and Namibia, and **"these actions prompted a second invasion from Rwanda and Uganda, triggering the Second Congo War in 1998"**. It adds that some historians view the two wars as one continuous conflict.
